mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `payment_reconciliation_issue` ( issue_key, biz_type, payment_no, biz_order_no, user_id, channel, issue_type, issue_level, issue_status, issue_message, payment_order_status, voucher_order_status, voucher_payment_status, payment_amount, recorded_refunded_amount, actual_refunded_amount, last_checked_time, resolved_time, resolved_by, resolve_note ) VALUES ( #{issueKey}, #{bizType}, #{paymentNo}, #{bizOrderNo}, #{userId}, #{channel}, #{issueType}, #{issueLevel}, #{issueStatus}, #{issueMessage}, #{paymentOrderStatus}, #{voucherOrderStatus}, #{voucherPaymentStatus}, #{paymentAmount}, #{recordedRefundedAmount}, #{actualRefundedAmount}, #{lastCheckedTime}, #{resolvedTime}, #{resolvedBy}, #{resolveNote} )
mapper.update: UPDATE `payment_reconciliation_issue` SET biz_type = #{bizType}, payment_no = #{paymentNo}, biz_order_no = #{bizOrderNo}, user_id = #{userId}, channel = #{channel}, issue_type = #{issueType}, issue_level = #{issueLevel}, issue_status = #{issueStatus}, issue_message = #{issueMessage}, payment_order_status = #{paymentOrderStatus}, voucher_order_status = #{voucherOrderStatus}, voucher_payment_status = #{voucherPaymentStatus}, payment_amount = #{paymentAmount}, recorded_refunded_amount = #{recordedRefundedAmount}, actual_refunded_amount = #{actualRefundedAmount}, last_checked_time = #{lastCheckedTime}, resolved_time = #{resolvedTime}, resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolve_note = #{resolveNote} WHERE issue_key = #{issueKey}

UPDATE `payment_reconciliation_issue` SET issue_status = 'RESOLVED', resolved_time = #{resolvedTime}, resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolve_note = #{resolveNote}, last_checked_time = #{resolvedTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalIssues, SUM(CASE WHEN issue_status = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS openIssues, SUM(CASE WHEN issue_status = 'RESOLVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolvedIssues, SUM(CASE WHEN issue_level = 'CRITICAL' AND issue_status = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS criticalOpenIssues FROM `payment_reconciliation_issue`

SELECT po.payment_no AS paymentNo, po.biz_type AS bizType, po.biz_order_no AS bizOrderNo, po.user_id AS userId, po.channel AS channel, po.status AS paymentOrderStatus, po.amount AS paymentAmount, po.refunded_amount AS recordedRefundedAmount, vo.status AS voucherOrderStatus, vo.payment_status AS voucherPaymentStatus, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(pro.refund_amount) FROM `payment_refund_order` pro WHERE pro.payment_no = po.payment_no AND pro.status = 'SUCCESS' ), 0) AS actualRefundedAmount FROM `payment_order` po LEFT JOIN `voucher_order` vo ON po.biz_type = 'VOUCHER' AND vo.order_no = po.biz_order_no WHERE po.create_time >= #{sinceTime} ORDER BY po.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT vo.order_no AS bizOrderNo, vo.user_id AS userId, vo.payment_method AS channel, vo.status AS voucherOrderStatus, vo.payment_status AS voucherPaymentStatus, vo.pay_amount AS paymentAmount FROM `voucher_order` vo LEFT JOIN `payment_order` po ON po.biz_type = 'VOUCHER' AND po.biz_order_no = vo.order_no WHERE vo.create_time >= #{sinceTime} AND vo.payment_status IN (1, 3) AND po.id IS NULL ORDER BY vo.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
